title: Beef and mushroom stew with pearl onions
blurb: Tender beef simmered in a rich broth with mushrooms and pearl onions
steps: Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and season with salt and pepper. Toss the beef in the plain flour until evenly coated.
Heat half the olive oil in a large heavy-based pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil to the pot and cook the pearl onions until golden, then add the crushed garlic and cook for one minute.
Pour in the wine and beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Stir in the tomato puree, thyme and bay leaves.
Return the beef to the pot, bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover and cook gently for 90 minutes.
Quarter the mushrooms and add them to the pot. Continue simmering uncovered for another 30 minutes until the beef is very tender.
Mix the cornstarch with two tablespoons of cold water to form a paste. Stir this into the stew and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Remove the thyme sprigs and bay leaves, check the seasoning and serve.
